idea-plugin.name: Dioxus Buddy
idea-plugin.description:
Dioxus Buddy adds local preview sandbox actions for Dioxus Rust components.
Features: - Detects Rust functions marked with #[component], #[dioxus_preview], or #[preview] - Adds a gutter icon and editor action for preview targets - Generates a local .dioxus-buddy preview crate - Runs dx serve in the IDE Run tool window

action.description: Run a local Dioxus web preview for the macro-marked Rust function
